restore.collections.items.reason: items in the snapshot; a restore that loses items is a failed restore

migrations.applied.reason: the eight migrations pending in production (seven older ones and invoice-ledger-indexes)

backfill.created.log-only.reason: portal invoices known only from the old log, after items superseded by a later Xero row are moved

backfill.created.xero-only.reason: items whose only record is a Xero row

backfill.found.unplaceable.reason: invoices the backfill cannot place (no participant, or no derivable total); they need a person

backfill.found.unplaceableLedgerRows.reason: document rows with no invoice number

backfill.found.deletedItems.reason: old-log rows whose item no longer exists

backfill.found.duplicateNumbers.reason: one number held by several participants or boards in the old data, all in test workspaces 55369 and 55390

backfill.found.xeroSpansInvoices.reason: a Xero number covering a portal invoice and items on no invoice

backfill.found.supersededByXero.reason: D9: items moved from a portal invoice to a later Xero invoice

backfill.found.supersededPortalInvoices.reason: portal invoices (per participant) left with no item after D9

markers.toMark.reason: logged items with no marker; the same 368 as audit query 6

markers.fromXero.reason: D9: the later row is a Xero row (200 superseded plus 16 Xero only)

markers.fromPdf.reason: the later row is a PDF row
